attempts.summary: Created an SSH host CA on node1 (/etc/ssh/ca/ssh_host_ca), signed node1's ed25519 host public key into /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub (principals node1, 10.100.43.10, 10y validity), and configured sshd via HostCertificate directive. Verified a client trusting only the CA's public key (via an @cert-authority known_hosts line, no pinned host key) connects successfully under StrictHostKeyChecking=yes, with sshd debug output showing 'matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate'. Falsified by showing the same client fails with an empty known_hosts. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, triggered `shutdown -r now`, polled until SSH returned, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified sshd active, the host certificate still served, and CA-trust-only connection still succeeding post-reboot. Cleaned up all temporary test artifacts (test known_hosts files, temporary SSH keypair, appended authorized_keys entry) added purely for verification.
